concepts.gloss_en: Clapping of the hands during prayer (the act specifically qualified as occurring in prayer)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences (lm1:45 and lm1:46) refer to the same act — clapping hands during prayer. The surface variants differ only lexically (כַּפַּיִם 'hands' vs. כַּף 'hand', and בַּתְּפִלָּה 'in prayer' vs. בִּשְׁעַת הַתְּפִלָּה 'at the time of prayer'), which is inflectional/phrasal variation of the same concept, not a homograph split. Round-1 grouping stands.
